test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

I want to spend some time in the forest passing with trees and enjoying the natural beauty.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in **part 3** of the sentence: "**forest passing with trees**."
 
• The word "**passing**" is contextually incorrect here. A forest is typically described by what it contains or is composed of.
 
• The correct prepositional phrase or adjective should be "**filled with**," "**teeming with**," or "**dense with**" to indicate the presence of trees.
 
• "Passing" usually refers to movement or the passage of time, which does not fit the description of a static forest environment in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I want to spend some time in the **forest filled with** trees and enjoying the natural beauty."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "I want to spend"** – This part is grammatically correct, using the subject followed by the appropriate verb and infinitive.
 
• **Option 2: "some time in the"** – This part is correct as it properly uses the quantifier "some" with the uncountable noun "time."
 
• **Option 4: "and enjoying the natural beauty."** – This part is correct; it maintains parallel structure with "spending" (implied) or functions as a gerund phrase describing the activity.
